title: 214. The secret to love? Go SLOW ft. Therapist Moe Ari Brown

sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一档iHeart播客，保证真人录制。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切合实际的方式努力将健康放在首位，而让我保持动力的秘诀就是我的WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这也是我热爱WHOOP的原因，因为我能真正看清为什么我的身体在不同的日子会有不同的感受，为什么我的跑步状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我可能注意力不够集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能轻松追踪我的睡眠、运动强度、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，还有我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有的这些数据和规律，以便我能够做出更好的决策，这包括知道什么时候该轻松应对，什么时候该全力以赴。

sentences.zh: 新用户在正式订阅会员之前，可以先通过30天免费试用体验WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.

sentences.zh: 萨姆探索了那些成为你性格一部分的记忆、执念和微小珍宝。

sentences.en: Charmed is warm, it's funny, it's nostalgic, and just full of the little moments and memories that make life matter.
sentences.zh: 《魅力》温暖、幽默、怀旧，充满了那些让生命变得意义非凡的点滴瞬间和回忆。

sentences.zh: 《魅力》，由萨姆·托德主持。

sentences.zh: 潘多拉倾情呈现，值得细细倾听的故事。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《你二十岁的心理学》，这是一档探讨我们在二十岁时经历的重大生活变化与转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及这些变化对我们的心理意味着什么的播客。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目中。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here, back for another episode as we break down the psychology of your 20s
sentences.zh: 新听众、老听众，无论你身处世界的哪个角落，很高兴你能来到这里，收看新的一期节目，和我们一起剖析二十岁的心理学，

sentences.en: and back for another dating episode.
sentences.zh: 并且又迎来了一期关于约会的节目。

sentences.en: I think we all kind of want to know the secret to love, right, the secret not just to finding our person, but also making it last
sentences.zh: 我想我们大家可能都想知道爱的秘诀是什么，对吧，不仅是找到对的人的秘诀，也是让关系持久的秘诀，

sentences.en: and making the relationship healthy and sustainable and fulfilling for not just the next few months, but hopefully the next few years, maybe our entire lives.
sentences.zh: 并且让这段关系不仅在接下来的几个月里，而且在未来的几年里，甚至可能是我们的一生中，保持健康、可持续且充满成就感。

sentences.en: There are a lot of different dating tips, dating advice out there around how exactly to do that.
sentences.zh: 市面上有很多关于具体该如何做不同的约会小贴士和约会建议。

sentences.en: But what I've found is that if you really want true, long-lasting love, if you want to find somebody in your 20s, in your 30s, whenever you are ready,
sentences.zh: 但我发现，如果你真的想要真正的、长久的爱，如果你想在你二十多岁、三十多岁，或者任何你准备好的时候找到某个人，

sentences.en: instead of just rushing into any connection that passes you by, instead of really getting swept up in big romances and big love affairs that burn very, very bright, go slow.
sentences.zh: 与其急于投入任何擦肩而过的感情，与其真正陷入那些燃烧得非常非常猛烈的大型浪漫和恋情中，不如放慢脚步。

sentences.en: Approach love, approach dating, any of those endeavors as kind of like a scenic drive.
sentences.zh: 把恋爱、约会或任何此类尝试看作是一场风景优美的自驾游。

sentences.en: You're getting to know them.
sentences.zh: 你在慢慢了解对方。

sentences.en: You're not rushing into things.
sentences.zh: 你没有急于求成。

sentences.en: It should be, you know, smooth and easy and carefree and fun.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它应该是顺其自然、轻松愉快且无忧无虑的。

sentences.en: And I think that, you know, amongst all the noise and all the dating advice, maybe what we really need is more emotional vulnerability and emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在所有的喧嚣和约会建议中，也许我们真正需要的是更多的情感脆弱性和情感亲密度。

sentences.en: And that definitely comes with time.
sentences.zh: 而这绝对需要时间来培养。

sentences.en: So today we are going to be talking about just that, this approach to dating, the slow man, the slow burn, low pressure first dates, all of those things.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们就来聊聊这个，这种约会方式、慢热、慢节奏的恋爱、低压力的初次约会，以及所有这些事情。

sentences.en: And we are also going to bring on an incredible guest, somebody who knows so much more about this than I do and can provide us some insight.
sentences.zh: 我们还将请来一位不可思议的嘉宾，他对这方面的了解比我多得多，能为我们提供一些深刻见解。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 话不多说，我们切入正题。

sentences.en: Today we have on the wonderful Mo.
sentences.zh: 今天我们请到了优秀的Mo。

sentences.en: They are a licensed marriage and family therapist and the love and connection expert at Hinge to talk about this amazing topic.
sentences.zh: 他们是一名持证婚姻与家庭治疗师，也是Hinge的爱与连接专家，来和我们探讨这个精彩的话题。

sentences.en: Can you introduce yourself and a bit of your work?
sentences.zh: 你能自我介绍一下并简单说说你的工作吗？

sentences.en: Yay, thank you.
sentences.zh: 耶，谢谢。

sentences.en: That was a beautiful introduction.
sentences.zh: 这是一段非常棒的介绍。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来参加。

sentences.en: I am, well, you said I am.
sentences.zh: 我是，嗯，你刚才说了我是。

sentences.en: I am a licensed marriage and family therapist and the love and connection expert at Hinge.
sentences.zh: 我是一名持证婚姻与家庭治疗师，也是Hinge的爱与连接专家。

sentences.en: Over the past decade,
sentences.zh: 在过去的十年里，

sentences.en: I've been working with individuals, families, couples on relationships.
sentences.zh: 我一直致力于为个人、家庭和伴侣提供关系咨询。

sentences.en: So relationships has been my focus of my work and that spans the life journey.
sentences.zh: 因此，人际关系一直是我工作的核心，并且跨越了整个人生旅程。

sentences.en: It spans a variety of life experiences.
sentences.zh: 它涵盖了各种各样的生活经历。

sentences.en: I identify as non-binary transgender.
sentences.zh: 我的自我认同是非二元性别跨性别者。

sentences.en: So I am a part of the LGBTQIA plus community.
sentences.zh: 所以我是LGBTQIA加号社群的一员。

sentences.en: I use they, them, or he, him pronouns.
sentences.zh: 我使用的代词是they/them或者he/him。

sentences.en: And yeah, I am excited about all of the work
sentences.zh: 是的，我对我在Hinge所做的所有工作

sentences.en: I've been doing at Hinge.
sentences.zh: 都感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Basically, what I'm doing at Hinge is pairing all of that experience as a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我在Hinge所做的事情是将我作为治疗师的所有经验结合起来，

sentences.en: And I am joining that with Hinge's data-backed insights around dating and relationships to offer daters valuable advice on and off of the app
sentences.zh: 并将其与Hinge围绕约会和关系的基于数据的洞察相结合，为寻找对象的人们提供应用内外的宝贵建议，

sentences.en: about connection and creating meaningful partnership.
sentences.zh: 内容关于连接以及建立有意义的伴侣关系。

sentences.en: You want to know something interesting?
sentences.zh: 你想知道一件有趣的事吗？

sentences.en: I didn't even, I don't think I even told you this.
sentences.zh: 我甚至，我想我都没跟你说过这个。

sentences.en: I actually met my partner on Hinge.
sentences.zh: 我其实是在Hinge上认识我的伴侣的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So I'm really excited to like get into this because I honestly didn't even, of course I knew how we met, but I hadn't even like clocked
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很兴奋能深入探讨这个话题，因为老实说我甚至都没，当然我知道我们是怎么认识的，但我甚至没有意识到

sentences.en: that there would be that late until just then.
sentences.zh: 会有这样的巧合，直到刚才那一刻。

sentences.en: So I'm excited to talk about this as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我很高兴能聊聊这个。

sentences.en: And not just obviously like you, you just have this wealth of knowledge from having literal access to our dating data, which is like insane.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅因为你，你拥有丰富的知识，因为你可以直接接触到我们的约会数据，这简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: But also this concept that you talk about a lot of the slow burn and slow manse, which I think is wonderful.
sentences.zh: 还有你经常谈到的这个慢热和慢节奏恋爱的概念，我觉得非常棒。

sentences.en: Let's actually address the Hinge's new data report firstly, because I get so many questions from people in their 20s being like, what is the correct way to be dating right now?
sentences.zh: 我们首先来谈谈Hinge的全新数据报告吧，因为我从很多二十多岁的人那里收到过很多问题，比如：现在谈恋爱正确的打开方式是什么？

sentences.en: Am I doing this right?
sentences.zh: 我这样对吗？

sentences.en: Like I want to find the love of my life or I want something more casual and it feels like I just can't crack the code.
sentences.zh: 就像我想找到此生挚爱，或者我想要更随意的关系，但感觉我就是无法破解其中的密码。

sentences.en: So can you explain some of the key findings from this report?
sentences.zh: 所以你能解释一下这份报告的一些关键发现吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: I am excited to hear more about how you and your partner's met.
sentences.zh: 我很期待听到更多关于你和你的伴侣是如何相识的故事。

sentences.en: And so we released very recently our new dating report called the LGBTQIA plus date report that stands for data advice, trends and expertise.
sentences.zh: 我们最近发布了全新的约会报告，名为LGBTQIA加号约会报告，代表着数据、建议、趋势和专业知识（data advice, trends and expertise）。

sentences.en: And inside of that report, we surveyed many queer daters on our app and we found that 76% of queer Hinge daters say that they wish that they had more
sentences.zh: 在这份报告中，我们调查了我们应用程序上的许多酷儿约会者，我们发现76%的酷儿Hinge约会者表示，他们希望在成长过程中能有更多

sentences.en: positive, healthy examples of relationships when they were growing up.
sentences.zh: 积极、健康的恋爱关系榜样。

sentences.en: And so we know that there are often these gaps in representation for the queer community.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们知道酷儿社群中往往存在这些代表性的缺失。

sentences.en: So we're hoping to fill some of that space with more information, support, celebration of queer daters.
sentences.zh: 所以我们希望通过更多信息、支持和对酷儿约会者的庆祝来填补这部分空白。

sentences.en: And so I'm really honored to be in this role where I get to take part in that.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能担任这个角色并参与其中。

sentences.en: The number one topic that we found that queer Hinge daters want to learn more about is emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 我们发现酷儿Hinge约会者最想了解的话题就是情感亲密度。

sentences.en: So when we think about the foundation of relationship and building long-term connections, I often think, especially as a therapist, emotional intimacy is central to that.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们思考关系的基石和建立长久连接时，我常常认为，尤其作为一名治疗师，情感亲密度是其中的核心。

sentences.en: 50% of queer Hinge daters say that they want to learn how to build truSt.
sentences.zh: 50%的酷儿Hinge约会者表示他们想学习如何建立信任。

sentences.en: And so these core topics, emotional intimacy, trust, not throw in communication, collaboration, all of these things support the foundation of relationships
sentences.zh: 所以这些核心话题——情感亲密度、信任，更不用说沟通、协作了——所有这些都支撑着关系的基石，

sentences.en: and they're essential to what we're calling at Hinge, slow man's.
sentences.zh: 并且它们正是我们在Hinge上所说的“慢节奏恋爱”的核心要素。

sentences.en: And I'm happy to get even more into that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意更深入地探讨这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, so I want to focus on this first thing that you said, which is that so many people want more emotional intimacy.
sentences.zh: 我想重点谈谈你刚才说的第一点，那就是很多人都渴望更多的情感亲密度。

sentences.en: And I do feel like the nature of dating in our 20s sometimes, like before I met my partner, it definitely felt like this is a transaction.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实觉得有时我们二十多岁时的约会性质，比如在我遇到伴侣之前，那种感觉绝对就像是一场交易。

sentences.en: And especially like I was on the apps and I think I got kind of very cynical about it for a while.
sentences.zh: 特别是当我使用约会软件时，有一段时间我对它变得相当愤世嫉俗。

sentences.en: Quite cynical because I was like, everything just feels like there is either a want for like something physical immediately or pretty quickly, or it's like the same conversations
sentences.zh: 相当愤世嫉俗，因为我觉得一切都好像要么是立刻或很快就想要某种肉体关系，要么就是一遍又一遍重复着同样的对话，

sentences.en: again and again and again that never let go much deeper.
sentences.zh: 永远不会有更深入的进展。

sentences.en: And I also think that the reason we kind of hold back emotionally sometimes when we are in that environment is because we have so many like options, right?
sentences.zh: 而且我也认为，我们在那种环境中会有时在情感上有所保留，原因是我们有太多的选择，对吧？

sentences.en: And we don't want to get vulnerable with the wrong person.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不想把脆弱的一面展现给错的人。

sentences.en: Does that like concern you at all?
sentences.zh: 这会让你感到担心吗？

sentences.en: Like what capacity to build long-term relationships?
sentences.zh: 比如建立长期关系的能力？

sentences.en: That's a really, really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常非常好的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What I'm hearing you saying is that there are all of these
sentences.zh: 我听到你说的是，有所有这些

sentences.en: different worries or challenges that get in the way of us making meaningful connections very early on.
sentences.zh: 不同的担忧或挑战，阻碍了我们在早期建立有意义的连接。

sentences.en: So in that, at first I was holding so much empathy and space as a therapist and I hope energetically you felt that.
sentences.zh: 所以对此，作为一名治疗师，我首先抱有极大的同理心和包容，我希望你在能量层面上能感受到这一点。

sentences.en: I know I really did.
sentences.zh: 我知道我真的感受到了。

sentences.en: I feel like, I think your story and what you're saying relates to how many people are feeling or many of their, many people's experiences.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，我认为你的故事和你的言论契合了许多人的感受或许多人的经历。

sentences.en: Many people are coming to the table with worries about whether or not they'll be received in a relationship or that someone will like them back.
sentences.zh: 许多人带着对自己在关系中是否会被接纳，或者对方是否也会喜欢自己的担忧来到这里。

sentences.en: And so I think a lot of what prevents us from showing up authentically, being vulnerable, leaning in, having the seemingly challenging conversations
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，阻碍我们展现真实自我、表露脆弱、倾心投入、进行看似充满挑战的对话的很大一部分原因，

sentences.en: is this desire to be received well.
sentences.zh: 是这种想要被良好接纳的渴望。

sentences.en: So if we're worried that we'll be rejected, we'll often just prevent ourselves from leaning in.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们担心会被拒绝，我们通常就会阻止自己去投入。

sentences.en: So my advice would be for daters to become really intimately aware of that voice that is creating these narratives inside of us.
sentences.zh: 因此，我的建议是让约会者们对内心创造这些叙事的那个声音有非常亲密且深刻的觉察。

sentences.en: It's often in our voice, but the narrative itself is important because if we're not aware that we're telling ourselves you're not enough or that we're afraid
sentences.zh: 它通常是我们的声音，但叙事本身很重要，因为如果我们没有意识到我们在对自己说“你不够好”，或者我们害怕

sentences.en: that we won't be enough or that we're afraid that we'll be rejected like that time we were rejected in high school or whatever the narrative is, then we can't go about changing it.
sentences.zh: 自己不够好，或者我们害怕像高中时那样被拒绝（无论这种叙事是什么），那么我们就无法去改变它。

sentences.en: So I often take a narrative approach as a therapist, meaning that I work on shifting the stories that we tell ourselves that often form limiting beliefs
sentences.zh: 所以作为一名治疗师，我经常采用叙事疗法，这意味着我致力于改变我们对自己讲述的故事，这些故事往往形成了限制性信念，

sentences.en: that keep us from our goals.
sentences.zh: 阻碍我们实现目标。

sentences.en: And so the first step in that narrative therapy approach is to really get clear on what the narratives are.
sentences.zh: 因此，叙事疗法的第一步就是真正弄清楚这些叙事是什么。

sentences.en: So that's the first step.
sentences.zh: 所以这是第一步。

sentences.en: And I want that to be people's homework.
sentences.zh: 我希望这成为人们的家庭作业。

sentences.en: I don't want you to do anything beyond that.
sentences.zh: 我不希望你们做超出这一步的任何事情。

sentences.en: Just like focus on becoming aware of what those narratives are that are preventing vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 只需专注于去觉察那些阻碍脆弱性的叙事到底是什么。

sentences.en: And I think when we talk about dating in this day and age, just dating in general,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为当我们谈论当今时代的约会，也就是泛泛的约会时，

sentences.en: sometimes we do mask our emotional intimacy or mask our need for emotional intimacy with physicality, right?
sentences.zh: 有时我们确实会用肉体关系来掩饰我们的情感亲密度，或者掩饰我们对情感亲密度的需求，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like, okay, I can speed up this relationship physically and it feels exciting and it feels new without ever actually having to connect with this person on a deeper level.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，我可以在身体上加快这段关系的发展，这感觉很刺激、很新鲜，而实际上根本不需要在更深层次上与这个人建立连接。

sentences.en: And I think that's kind of part of our inclination to just dive straight in to a new relationship.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们倾向于直接一头扎进新恋情中的一部分原因。

sentences.en: Are you kind of, have you seen that yourself?
sentences.zh: 你是否也有过这种感觉？

sentences.en: Like the need to, not to say that like, take your time, like do whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 比如这种需求——并不是说，放慢脚步，随心所欲吧。

sentences.en: It's your body.
sentences.zh: 这是你的身体。

sentences.en: It's your choice.
sentences.zh: 这是你的选择。

sentences.en: But sometimes like, and I will say, I noticed this in myself when I was dating.
